headline: Deckers Outdoor (DECK) Stock Fair Value Edges Lower As Analysts Weigh Mixed Outlook
summary: Deckers Outdoor has seen its fair value estimate move from about US$126.86 to about US$122.81, pointing to a slightly lower implied price target in recent model updates. That shift lines up with research where some analysts trim targets while still emphasizing the strength of Deckers Outdoor's brands and direct to consumer performance.
